prompts.title: Daily Reflection
prompts: What made you smile today?
What are you grateful for right now?
What challenged you today and how did you handle it?
What did you learn about yourself today?
How can you make tomorrow better than today?

prompts.title: Gratitude Journal
prompts: List three things you're grateful for today
Who made a positive impact on your life recently?
What simple pleasure did you enjoy today?
What aspect of your health are you thankful for?
What opportunity are you grateful for?

prompts.title: Anxiety Journal
prompts: What's making you anxious right now?
What evidence do you have that this worry will come true?
What evidence do you have that it won't?
What's the worst that could happen? How would you cope?
What would you tell a friend who had this worry?

prompts.title: Goal Reflection
prompts: What progress did you make toward your goals today?
What obstacles are you facing?
What small step can you take tomorrow?
How does working toward this goal make you feel?
Who can support you in achieving this goal?

prompts.title: Dream Journal
prompts: Describe your dream in detail
What emotions did you feel in the dream?
What symbols or themes appeared?
How might this dream relate to your waking life?
What message might your subconscious be sending?

prompts.title: Mindfulness Log
prompts: What did you notice in your environment today?
When were you fully present today?
What sensory experiences stood out?
What thoughts passed through your mind?
How did your body feel throughout the day?
